flags.message: Forward signal predating the snapshot shaped this forecast: PhRMA's time to petition from the Fifth Circuit's published Louisiana 340B decision (AbbVie v. Murrill) was extended to 2026-11-03 (application 26A356), and the Fourth Circuit granted rehearing en banc in PhRMA v. McCuskey on 2026-05-28. The grant probability here is mostly the chance this petition rides a grant or hold of the Louisiana companion; it is not this case's disposition and nothing retrieved revealed one.
